questions.cardDe: Welche Stadt liegt am nördlichsten: Barcelona, New York oder Rom?
questions.de: Welche europäische Hauptstadt liegt auf rund 41,9 Grad nördlicher Breite und damit nördlicher als Barcelona und New York?
questions.en: Which European capital lies at about 41.9 degrees north, and thus further north than Barcelona and New York?
questions.notes: Card's multiple choice reworked. Rome 41°53′36″N, Barcelona 41°23′N, New York City about 40°42′N. The founding date 753 BC is the traditional legendary date.

questions.cardDe: Wer regierte von 1928 bis 1939 Albanien: König Zigo, Zogo oder Zugo?
questions.de: Unter welchem Herrschernamen regierte Ahmet Zogu von 1928 bis 1939 als König Albanien?
questions.en: Under what regnal name did Ahmet Zogu rule Albania as king from 1928 to 1939?

timeline.labelEn: Ahmet Zogu reigns as Zog I, King of the Albanians
timeline.labelDe: Ahmet Zogu regiert als Zogu I., König der Albaner

questions.notes: Card's three options removed. The card spells the intended answer 'Zogo'; the German form is Zogu I. (English Zog I). He was president 1925–1928 and fled after Italy invaded in April 1939.

questions.de: Das Maskottchen welcher Rockband brachte 1976 den Flugverkehr in London Heathrow zum Erliegen?
questions.en: The mascot of which rock band brought air traffic at London Heathrow to a standstill in 1976?

timeline.labelEn: Pink Floyd's inflatable pig breaks loose over London during the Animals cover shoot
timeline.labelDe: Pink Floyds aufblasbares Schwein reißt sich beim Fotoshooting für Animals über London los

questions.notes: Card's three options removed. The 40 ft helium pig (later called Algie) drifted across Heathrow's flight lanes and landed in Kent.

questions.de: Welcher Elektronikriese verschenkte 2016 insgesamt 12.500 nagelneue Handys an die Athleten der Sommerolympiade in Rio?
questions.en: Which electronics giant gave away a total of 12,500 brand-new mobile phones to the athletes at the 2016 Summer Olympics in Rio?

timeline.labelEn: Samsung gives Olympic edition Galaxy S7 Edge phones to athletes at the Rio Summer Olympics
timeline.labelDe: Samsung schenkt den Athleten der Sommerspiele in Rio Olympia-Editionen des Galaxy S7 Edge

questions.notes: The phones were special Olympic editions of the Galaxy S7 Edge; the source confirms they were given to athletes but does not state the figure 12,500.
